title: CRISPR observability: software and source-bound scientific evidence

creators.name: Firmenich, Facundo
creators.affiliation: Centro de Estudios del Sur (CEDESUR), Spain and Argentina

description:
Computational software and source-bound evidence for genome-editing observability, finite-record identification and sequence correspondence. The release includes the retained COL17A1 pair ledgers, source spans, target-class witnesses, bounded independent path oracle, executable reproduction entry point and epistemic claim/evidence graph. Historical CFTR/HEK3, K562, HG002, KEAP1 and fragment-linkage evidence is included in the Git tree; one large reference file is preserved as hash-verified reconstructable parts.

Original software: GPL-3.0-only, as selected by the author. Third-party notices and original-study data terms are retained. Manuscript, formal supplementary text and editable manuscript sources are excluded until author-confirmed bioRxiv acceptance. This computational release does not establish independent molecular truth or biological accuracy.
